text: D215445 explicitly kept two copies and required matching placement after testModifyItemWithNoChanges. Current two provider files retain the same testPutSpecialCharactersInUID case. Maintain both harnesses when a fix affects both provider modes; removing one copy merely to deduplicate can remove a contract check. This is scoped to the existing CalDAV split, not a general prohibition on shared test helpers.
title: Keep matching regression cases in cached and uncached provider suites
